summary: Managed web terminals for fully enrolled nodes, with a restricted systemd PTY, single-use admission and signed process-group cleanup. Full enrollment continues to support node commands and managed cron without accepting raw SSH disconnects as completion evidence.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_MANAGED_TERMINAL_USER
newOptionalEnv.description: Dedicated non-root account without supplementary groups for restricted managed terminals. Requires privileged mode, the execution supervisor and full node enrollment; unset keeps this feature disabled.
